long_biography.plain_text:
Deployed Resources cofounder Robert Napior came to temporary infrastructure through commercial construction and outdoor music festivals. At Detroit's A.O. Misch Construction, he managed projects including bank branches and the American Automobile Association's headquarters in Dearborn. He had studied business management at Wayne State University before spending more than a decade in construction.

In 1989 he took over Event Logistics in Brookline, New Hampshire, organising the infrastructure needed for large, multi-day camping festivals. His projects included Phish events and the early years of Bonnaroo. Away from business, he collects classic cars.
